items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Willenberg-Joy, I remember he'd play a lot of your breaks and everything.

ctx.x: Well you know some of the old Ken Collier things sound a lot like it too. Willenberg-Joy, I remember he'd play a lot of your breaks and everything.
